claims.text:
27. persistence-forecast

Target / packet: ai-persistence-forecast · F1. Prerequisites: ai:baseline-first.

Nearest / distinct payoff: baseline-first → ai-baseline-first. A majority baseline concerns classification; this persistence baseline uses only the last time-series observation and tests a trend/reversal countercase.

Finite primary model: Series[10,11,12,13], forecast next 14? Persistence predicts last observed 13; declared actual next 14 gives absolute error 1. Trend extrapolator uses last difference 1 and predicts 14, error 0.

Countercase and mathematical boundary: If next actual reverses to 12, persistence error 1 while trend error 2. Predictions use only past values; persistence is a baseline, not always inferior.

Predict and recall transfer: Predict both forecasts before actual revealed; recall flat next 13 gives persistence error 0 and trend 1.

Required observable evidence: Keep observed history, sealed next value and both predictions distinct; no use of future labels during forecast construction.
